description: Peter's unstable mutation drives the Neogenic Nightmare as the Insidious Six, Morbius, Blade, the Punisher, Man-Spider and the Tablet of Time turn his own changing body into the season's central danger.

s02e01.description: With Spider-Man's powers mysteriously failing, the Kingpin assembles six of his most dangerous enemies to overwhelm him together.

s02e02.description: Captured and unmasked while weakened, Peter must bluff the Insidious Six and survive long enough to understand what is happening to his powers.

s02e03.description: Mary Jane's obsessive former boyfriend returns as Hydro-Man, using his water-based powers to stalk her and challenge Spider-Man.

s02e04.description: Fearing his own mutation is accelerating, Spider-Man seeks help from the X-Men and uncovers a scientist exploiting anti-mutant fear.

s02e05.description: Spider-Man joins the X-Men against Herbert Landon's anti-mutant scheme after the supposedly human scientist undergoes a monstrous transformation.

s02e06.description: Michael Morbius is transformed by an experiment involving Peter's blood into a creature driven to drain life energy from others.

s02e07.description: As Peter's mutation grows worse, the Punisher mistakes Spider-Man for a dangerous criminal and begins hunting him across the city.

s02e08.description: Peter mutates fully into Man-Spider, leaving Kraven and Dr. Crawford racing to capture him and administer a cure.

s02e09.description: Blade arrives hunting Morbius, while Spider-Man tries to stop the vampire without allowing the relentless hunter to kill him.

s02e10.description: Morbius seeks a cure and Felicia becomes involved, drawing Spider-Man and Blade into another confrontation with the living vampire.

s02e11.description: Kingpin and Silvermane compete for an ancient tablet said to grant youth, using kidnapped hostages to force its secrets into the open.

s02e12.description: The Tablet of Time transforms Silvermane in an unexpected way, turning the crime war over immortality into a struggle to undo its effects.

s02e13.description: The Vulture develops technology that steals youth from others and targets Spider-Man while Peter's unstable mutation again threatens his body.

s02e14.description: Spider-Man seeks a final cure for his mutation as the Vulture, Scorpion and Smythe converge around the technology that could save or destroy him.
